# Fault planting (A.U35.04, A.U35.05)

Requirement: one fault-planting pass per module in a throwaway worktree through `audit/sweeps/plant.py` (absent at `f3fff0e`: the campaign writes it), nothing kept (A.U35.04); two plants per memory gate, each message worded clear of both memory markers, and every check-style test triggered (A.U35.05); A.U21.13's one-time unpatched modlwip control run (M.PROC.027 (1)). Completion: every plant caught, or its survivor turned into an action. A defect any file records goes the OR12.a path (fixed with a regression test seen failing first, or an owner question), never a note alone, and passes A-C as a delta before it is applied (OR106.a). The file is complete when every row is terminal: biting, fixed, or justified with its reason. Opened by A.U35.01 / M.PROC.022 (agent, 2026-10-22); deleted with `audit/` at phase D.

Method (agent, 2026-10-27): `audit/sweeps/plant.py` copies a frozen snapshot of the tree once, then per plant copies it to `/dev/shm/cfr_plant/<id>`, applies one fault from `plant_set.py` (a regex that must match its stated line count), regenerates the device modules when the fault is in `src/`, `buildgen/` or `devices/`, runs the named test files (MicroPython files with build-standard at -1 and through `tests/_threshold_runner.py` at 32768; host files with pytest; JS with vitest), records red/green and the failing tests, removes the copy and checks it removed, and checks the planted file's snapshot hash unchanged (the whole snapshot at the run's end); every target file ran green unplanted first. Scope is the owner's ruling (owner, 2026-10-23): "Planting faults is a good measure for complex measurement tests (e.g. memory exhaustion, leaks, long running accumulating processes, multi layered or external dependencies, and similar), but not required for the straightforward tests (which I would assume to be the majority by far). Planting errors for those straightforward tests would be complete overkill." Planted: A.U35.04's named requests, the boot entry's five decisions, A.U35.35's K rows (the cap's comparison flipped, the check dropped), two plants per memory gate with an unplanted control, and the seeded picks whose tests are complex measurement tests, each with its reason; A.U35.05 (4)'s timing and soak checks are the named rows (allocation budget, leak rate, UART latency, Run 11). Every other module decision is one row per module: "not planted: straightforward logic". No widening (agent, 2026-10-27). A plant green on its module's direct tests is read: equivalent (its reason), or a gap given a direct test and re-planted red (CF1b's method, kept). Records: `S/u35/laneC/cfr/results.jsonl` (first pass, base c3866e12), `replant.jsonl` (the fixed tree); logs in `plant_logs/`. Counts: {COUNTS}.
